svg.title: A conditional decision frontier under recovery uncertainty
svg.desc: The assumed baseline cost difference is -0.5 basis points with combined residual uncertainty of plus or minus 0.1 basis points. Across retention z in [0,1], the upper cost difference is -0.4 plus M times max d(z), and the lower is -0.6 plus M times min d(z). The upper bound crosses zero at approximately 54.39 basis points of amplitude. The shaded interval represents assumed model uncertainty, not a statistical confidence interval.
svg.title: A conditional decision frontier under recovery uncertainty
